themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket complaints surged to 3 this week vs. a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 2300% spike (z-score 8.69)—suggesting either widespread basket overflow, removal, or damage across CD 210 this week.
evidence: 3 litter basket complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 8.69 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
reporting_angles: Map the 3 complaints to identify if they cluster in one neighborhood (Throgs Neck vs. Co-op City) or are citywide
Contact Sanitation to determine if baskets were removed for maintenance, are overflowing, or if a collection route failed

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs & Park Animals Spike
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about unleashed dogs and animals in parks both jumped to 3 each last week (vs. 0.2 weekly baseline)—a 1100% surge with z-scores of 6.35—indicating a potential pet control or park enforcement breakdown in CD 210.
evidence: Unleashed Dog complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% increase, z-score 6.35)
Animal in a Park complaints: 3 this week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% increase, z-score 6.35)
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Enforcement or NYPD Animal Cruelty Unit about whether they've noticed a pattern or staffing gaps
Talk to residents in high-complaint areas (Pelham Bay Park, Van Cortlandt areas) about safety concerns with off-leash dogs

themes_detail.label: Food Establishment Health Violations
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints jumped to 8 last week vs. a 3.5-per-week baseline—a 129% spike (z-score 4.02)—suggesting a cluster of health or operational violations affecting restaurants or food vendors across CD 210.
evidence: 8 food establishment complaints last week vs. 3.5 weekly average (129% increase)
Z-score of 4.02 indicates statistically significant anomaly
reporting_angles: Request DOHMH inspection records for CD 210 food establishments filed last week to identify specific violations (temperature, rodents, sanitation)
Interview health inspectors or community members about whether a particular restaurant chain or neighborhood cluster is driving complaints

themes_detail.label: E-Scooter Nuisance Escalation
themes_detail.summary: E-scooter complaints hit 5 two weeks ago vs. a 0.6-per-week baseline—a 700% surge (z-score 6.29)—suggesting emerging parking, safety, or sidewalk obstruction issues as micromobility devices proliferate in Throgs Neck/Co-op City.
evidence: 5 e-scooter complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.6 weekly average (700% increase, z-score 6.29)
Surge predates other recent spikes, indicating sustained new trend
reporting_angles: Verify which scooter-sharing operators (Lime, Bird, etc.) are active in CD 210 and whether they expanded service recently
Canvass residents about scooter safety, sidewalk blocking, and whether enforcement has occurred

themes_detail.label: Sanitation Worker Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Sanitation worker or vehicle complaints jumped to 4 last week vs. a 0.8-per-week baseline—a 433% spike (z-score 3.92)—suggesting potential service disruptions, vehicle damage, or worker conduct issues in CD 210.
evidence: 4 sanitation worker/vehicle complaints last week vs. 0.8 weekly average (433% increase)
Z-score of 3.92 indicates statistically significant anomaly
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY to determine if there were staffing shortages, equipment breakdowns, or route changes last week
Request specifics on the 4 complaints—are they about missed pickups, damaged property, or worker behavior?
